description: The quotient class of implication satisfies \([A\to B]=\neg[A]\vee[B]\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.class_implication.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf (A.impl B) =
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf A)ᶜ ⊔
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf B
